name: 5-Why Analysis
description: Root cause analysis with branching question paths
whenToUse: When a single concrete incident is to be traced to its root and the domain knowledge is in the room — not for statistical relationships across many cases.

invariants.uniqueIds: Every question in the tree has its own id.
invariants.parentLinks: A first-level question sits under no other; every other question names the id of the question it sits under.
invariants.knownCollapsed: Only an existing question can be collapsed.
